events.title: Social Security benefits to get a boost. And, Hasan Piker defends his rhetoric
events.description: Social Security benefits are set to get a boost to offset rising consumer prices. And, streamer Hasan Piker says the GOP's "guilt-by-association politics" won't drag Democrats down in the midterms.

events.title: Aboard an icebreaker, a writer got a closer look at the Arctic's 'Sea Change'
events.description: As polar ice melts in the Arctic, shipping lanes are opening up, making the region a new zone of superpower competition. Writer Rana Foroohar explains the stakes in Sea Change.

events.title: Zelenskyy sits down with NPR. And, Pope Leo diagnosed with lung cancer
events.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has a sit-down interview with NPR as Russia's full-scale invasion nears the 5-year mark. And, Pope Leo XIV has been diagnosed with lung cancer.
events.ticker_label: 🪖 Zelenskyy sits down with NPR. And, Pope Leo diagnosed with lung cancer

events.title: These workers help train robots who could one day steal their jobs
events.description: Factory workers in India are being asked to wear GoPro cameras to record the way they do their jobs. The ultimate goal is to train robots to take over. Will it work?

events.title: Police raid the major pro-opposition Halk TV channel in Turkey
events.description: Turkish police raided the Istanbul headquarters of an important pro-opposition television station on Wednesdazy, the day that jailed Istanbul Mayor Ekrem Imamoglu was set to start his defense against corruption charges.

events.title: Trump says execution of Fort Hood shooter will not be livestreamed
events.description: Trump said the execution of Nidal Malik Hasan can be viewed in person by families of the victims if they wish. The decision comes after bipartisan backlash regarding the Pentagon's plans to livestream the execution.
events.ticker_label: 🚨 Trump says execution of Fort Hood shooter will not be livestreamed

events.title: EU summit to focus on China, Ukraine and bloc budget
events.description: EU leaders meeting in Brussels will examine measures to curb the bloc's huge trade deficit with China. But they will also be looking to further agreement on the next EU budget ahead of some major elections next year.

events.title: Resignation of Bärbel Bas shines light on harsh era of German politics
events.description: German Labor Minister Bärbel Bas has stepped down, citing her need to grieve a loved one and leave behind the harsh realities of government. So how did German politics get so heated?

events.title: Hypersonic missiles highlight arms race on Korean Peninsula
events.description: Both South and North Korea have tested weapons feared by military planners for their speed and ability to maneuver in flight.
events.ticker_label: 🪖 Hypersonic missiles highlight arms race on Korean Peninsula

events.title: Thousands of German gamblers could sue for their money back
events.description: German gamblers may finally be able to beat the house, thanks to new court rulings in the EU and in Germany. The decisions could help gambling addicts — but the legal road might be difficult.

events.title: Marseille woes continue with a second consecutive Europa League defeat
events.description: Things are going from bad to worse for Marseille. The French side suffered their second defeat in as many Europa League matches, losing 1-0 to Olympiakos. Lyon, meanwhile, are heading in the opposite direction, having secured a win over Premier League side Crystal Palace. Rennes, for their part, claimed their first Europa League victory of the season with a narrow 2-1 win over OFI Crete.

events.title: France and Germany agree to ease EU car emissions rules in new deal
events.description: France and Germany have backed looser EU emissions rules for carmakers and agreed to include Britain in a “made in Europe” scheme, in a provisional deal reached Thursday that could reshape the bloc’s automotive and climate policies.

events.title: Brazil's Senate approves a shorter workweek in major win for Lula ahead of runoff
events.description: Brazil’s Senate has approved a constitutional amendment to reduce the maximum workweek from 44 to 40 hours without cutting salaries

events.title: China opens joint airfield in Laos with eyes on its military role
events.description: China’s newly opened joint military airfield in Laos is Beijing’s first overseas facility focused on air power

events.title: Ex-leader of N. Ireland’s largest unionist party sentenced to 15 years for sex abuse
events.description: The former leader of Northern Ireland’s largest unionist party has been on Thursday to 15 years in prison for the rape and sex abuse of two girls decades ago

events.title: Costa Rica opens a Bukele-style mega-prison. Here's how it got here
events.description: Costa Rica has made fighting drug trafficking a main goal, inspired by El Salvador's hardline approach

events.title: Prince Harry and Meghan to make first joint appearances since returning to UK
events.description: Prince Harry and Meghan are making their first joint public appearances in England since stepping back from royal duties six years ago

events.title: EU leaders push back on a major budget proposal, putting a deal by 2027 in doubt
events.description: European Union leaders are voicing strong opposition to a new proposal for the bloc’s long-term budget

events.title: New China-North Korea bridge opens after more than a decade of delay
events.description: A new bridge linking China and North Korea has opened after more than a decade of delay It's being touted as a symbol of the neighbors' traditional friendship and it signals deeper ties between the countries

events.title: FBI returns 'Most Wanted' fraudster to US after India arrest in alleged $600K SNAP food stamp scheme
events.description: FBI Director Kash Patel announced Manjit Singh Bedi, accused of stealing over $600,000 in SNAP benefits in Tacoma, has been returned from India.

events.title: Horse farm owner gets life in prison for boyfriend's murder after claiming self-defense
events.description: Caylen Deller claimed she shot Chad Mullen in self-defense at her Florida horse farm, but the jury rejected her testimony after just one hour.

events.title: Florida mom vanished after 'People's Court' airing, now ex-fiancé is arrested on murder charge 15 years later
events.description: Dale Smith Jr. was arrested on second-degree murder charge 15 years after Michelle Parker vanished the day their dispute aired on "The People's Court."

events.title: Lindsay Clancy holdout juror says everyone had phones as defense seeks only his records
events.description: Holdout juror Michael Desronvil reveals surveillance footage of journalists snooping through his mail and peering into windows after Clancy's mistrial.

events.title: Lindsay Clancy holdout explains 'methodical' slayings and more top headlines
events.description: Get all the stories you need-to-know from the most powerful name in news delivered first thing every morning to your inbox.

events.title: Christa Pike is back behind bars after botched execution, but her ultimate sentence faces a new test
events.description: Christa Pike's survival of lethal injection could raise double jeopardy and disability claims that may block Tennessee from executing her again.

events.title: Copper theft suspect's desperate escape caught on bodycam video before deputies discover what he left behind
events.description: Rayven Lee Wooten dove headfirst through a closed window to flee an Oklahoma deputy but left behind a backpack with a critical clue inside.

events.title: Lindsay Clancy mistrial holdout says he thought she was 'methodical' in the 'execution' of her children
events.description: Michael Desronvil, the lone holdout juror in the Lindsay Clancy mistrial, speaks out in his first televised interview about his vote to convict.

events.title: Trump wishes Pope Leo speedy recovery after lung cancer diagnosis, speaks highly of pontiff's brother
events.description: President Donald Trump revealed Pope Leo XIV's brother is a friend and avid MAGA supporter with memorabilia "all over" his house while wishing the pontiff well.

events.title: Pope Leo undergoes blood tests, X-ray following cancer surgery, Vatican says
events.description: Pope Leo XIV began walking and resumed eating after thoracic surgery at Rome's Gemelli Hospital, with blood tests and an X-ray being part of his recovery.

events.title: Pope Leo diagnosed with lung cancer after surgeons remove part of right lung, Vatican says
events.description: Pope Leo XIV arrived at Gemelli Hospital in Rome for lung nodule removal after doctors said the growth was identified at a "very early stage." Doctors later confirmed he had a form of lung cancer.
events.ticker_label: 💥 Pope Leo diagnosed with lung cancer after surgeons remove part of right lung, Vatican says
